summary: The two social OAuth Edge Functions still exchange and persist plaintext access/refresh tokens. supabase/functions/social-oauth persists plaintext to artist_social_integrations (artist scope) and returns plaintext tokens to the org callback; supabase/functions/social-analytics reads row.access_token plaintext from organization_social_integrations/artist_social_integrations and clears plaintext columns on token failure. INTG-007 stops the Next.js side from writing/reading plaintext: the org callback persists encrypted envelopes only and the token vault is encrypted-only/fail-closed. These Edge Functions must move to envelope persistence plus server-side decryption, or they become the only remaining plaintext surfaces once social OAuth is enabled.
completed: Inventory recorded: social-oauth artist-scope persist writes access_token/refresh_token plaintext into artist_social_integrations; org scope returns plaintext tokens to the (now encrypted-only) callback.
Inventory recorded: social-analytics reads row.access_token plaintext for provider calls and clears access_token/refresh_token/token_envelope columns on auth-style analytics errors.
Encrypted-at-rest boundary (lib/integrations/token-vault.ts) and encrypted-only org callback are implemented with fail-closed reads.
next_steps: Move artist_social_integrations persistence to the same encrypted-envelope contract (token_envelope/jsonb — the column set already exists on the org table; confirm artist table column set).

Decrypt server-side through the vault codec (encryptIntegrationSecret/decryptIntegrationSecret or decodeVaultSecret) before any provider API call; never emit plaintext tokens to logs or function responses.
Coordinate hosted Edge Function redeploy with the database lane when ready; org analytics stays disabled through RELEASE-008.
blockers: Hosted Edge Function deployment and migration applies are out of band (CP-051); providers remain disabled through RELEASE-008.
